column1: # tests/Inventory/reviewed.tsv — verdicts for rows tests/Inventory/tenant_query_sweep.php lists to read.
# key <TAB> verdict <TAB> note. Keys hash file + method + expression: an edited expression needs reading again.
# Verdicts: ok-context (the caller's shop, traced), ok-record (an owned record's shop or key), ok-self (the
# record itself, or one created in the same request), ok-token (a public token/slug by design), ok-uniqueness
# (a cross-shop existence check by design), ok-invariant / ok-fk-invariant (a guard or a write-side invariant),
# ok-fk-join / ok-join-shop (a join on a stored reference / with shop equality), ok-platform (platform-level by
# design; the entry guard and scope named), latent (no caller; unsafe if called as noted), earlier (read in the
# 11e91c3 round, file unchanged since; that round kept no per-row note). Rows on global tables only, and rows
# the scanner trusts, carry no verdict: the resolved inventory shows them as `global` and `trusted`.
